description: Unique identifier for the audio file (alphanumeric or stem)
Audio path relative to repository root (must be forward-slash or standard Windows path)
Official song title or composition name
Performing artist or composer (used for Feature 6 same-artist check)
Musical genre label (used for Stage 3 Influence Map and genre-specific null tests)
Compositional mechanism: acoustic / electronic / generative / field_recording
Ground-truth origin label: Human / AI (used for training Feature 4 classifier)
Ground-truth musical key if known (e.g. C Major or A Minor)
Ground-truth tempo in beats per minute (BPM)
